battery.configuration_amendment: R4 preserves the preregistered R3 scientific recipe; only worker source identity, run identity, and lower per-job/aggregate remaining-budget caps changed after R3 stopped on a telemetry-schema exception before final endpoint.
battery.jobs: Two seed-specific one-A100 jobs, each runs R1source, R4source, R4untiedsource sequentially.
battery.randomization: Each paired arm invokes seed_all(seed) before ItemGPT construction and uses same declared permutation seed.

comparability_tolerance.early_abort: After first 100 nominal updates, check every 1,000; abort an arm after two consecutive checks above 1% cumulative skipped updates. No compensation.
comparability_tolerance.paired_gap_scope: subset versus full_supported within each initialization seed
comparability_tolerance.reporting: Nominal updates/examples, applied updates, skipped updates, final scale, initial state SHA per arm. Preserve arms; if tolerance fails, make no matched comparison claim.

comparison_design: Two seeds; three modes; common full-supported exposure/order, batch, optimizer and evaluation. R4source vs R1source changes compute depth. R4source vs R4untiedsource compares shared versus untied core approximately (parameter counts differ). R4self is omitted; no no-reinjection contrast or source-access isolation claim.
configuration_amendment: Three-arm H256 fixed-dose quality battery using fused SDPA and torch.compile(mode=reduce-overhead), common B1024 chosen from measured end-to-end profiles. R4self is omitted before quality runs; no reinjection-specific attribution is claimed.

curve_assessment.checkpoint_selection: fixed final; intermediate metrics are diagnostic only
curve_assessment.underfit_interpretation: 32,000 optimizer updates per arm; do not claim training saturation without endpoint curves.

staging_policy.feature_arrays_staged_note: Whole-array bytes are staged for training/validation loaders; test indices are not copied, loaded, or scored.

evaluation.primary: fixed final 32.768M-example dose; full-test NDCG@100 R4source minus R1source and R4untiedsource; validation diagnostic only.
evaluation.test_data_access: after all final checkpoints and dose are fixed, use canonical 232049 full-test indices SHA 40dec332...; save per-query ranks and metrics for every arm; no selection on test

initialization.pairing: same-seed common initialized tensors; R4untiedsource stores four cloned core blocks

pilot.continue_condition: Use one common selected batch and fp16 across all four modes and both seeds; train exactly 32.768M examples per mode. Stop after profile if projected completion plus frozen full-test evaluation exceeds 21:20 UTC.
pilot.measured_profile_evidence: output/compile-R1source-gpu0.json and output/compile-R4untiedsource-gpu1.json; source SHA f8a7ec8c19194dc31cceb64d5ffad0827e93a83c61a4de348757ee7cfff928db; compiled worker SHA 6af021ba05aa2b71f7064e7abc49e14f7a6dd2de07e156571b906e01d98c8206.
pilot.profile_selection: B1024 locked by end-to-end torch.compile(mode=reduce-overhead) A100 profiles of R1source and R4untiedsource, exact AdamW beta2=.999 recipe; no quality metric used.

purpose: A100 context-length transfer: fixed four Huginn-inspired item-ID recurrence modes, common 32.768M full-supported examples per mode/seed, fresh random initialization.

evaluations.primary_endpoint: fixed final step; all four mode comparisons; no best-checkpoint selection

recipe.initialization: Huginn-inspired scale-aware truncated normal; fresh random latent state per query; all common initialized tensors identical across modes
recipe.learning_rate_schedule: constant 2e-4, transferred from successful from-scratch baseline; no warmup or decay
recipe.optimizer: AdamW, betas=(0.9,0.999), default epsilon, decoupled weight decay
recipe.optimizer_update_interpretation: Dose selected by timing only before training; batch size common across arms; FP16 skipped updates recorded without exposure compensation.

resources.accelerator: 2x A100 PCIe 40GB on authorized remote workspace

scope: A100x2; context length 256; one seed per GPU, four arms sequential per GPU; profile common batch/precision across both seeds before quality training.
